body:
We didn't explicitly add in platform-based output paths. @lukasz-m-maciejewski, I can see how this becomes confusing and difficult.

One way to handle this is to add [platform mappings](https://docs.bazel.build/versions/main/platforms-intro.html#platform-mappings), so that setting a platform with the `--platforms` flag also implies setting the corresponding `--cpu` flag, thus giving you different output directories.

This is something we should look into fixing long-term, however. @gregestren, I don't know the current state of your work on output paths, would that handle this or should we update Bazel's logic now?
/subscribe -- this is something that affects incremental builds for Android/Roboleaf now, where switching top level --platforms is a common workflow.

My output path work (https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8339#issuecomment-902302769) can help, but not for actions that legitimately need different results for different platforms. In those cases we legitimately want their artifacts to reside in different places.

Yes, platform mappings are a temporary migration carryover.

I think it's fair to consider this explicitly. I'm not sure why this principally needs to be different from `--cpu` behavior.
We definitely want to address this, but I'm not sure of the timeframe. Thanks for raising it.

issue.body: if using --platforms option, the build result to "bazel-out/k8-opt" directory, i want to "bazel-out/{platforms-opt}"

body:
The new flag `--experimental_platform_in_output_dir` will enable the new behavior, where a non-default target platform will become part of the output dir name, replacing the CPU name.

Eventually I'd like to make this flag a default, but there's a lot of cleanup that needs to happen first.
